deps: npm i -D typescript oxlint oxlint-tsgolint oxfmt jscpd knip

check: npx jscpd --exit-code 1 --ignore '**/node_modules/**,**/dist/**' . || { echo 'Duplicated code: extract it into one shared function and reuse it.'; exit 1; }
npx knip --no-progress --no-config-hints || { echo 'Unused code: delete it, or import it from an entry point if it is meant to be used.'; exit 1; }
